title: Extensible Software in the age of LLMs
summary: This article explores how Large Language Models are fundamentally changing how we think about software extensibility, moving beyond traditional plugin architectures toward AI-native extension mechanisms where models can dynamically understand and integrate new capabilities.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of building software that can adapt and extend its capabilities dynamically in the era of AI, rather than relying solely on rigid traditional extension points.
why_valuable: It provides a forward-looking architectural perspective on how software design must evolve when AI can serve as a universal adapter layer for extensibility.
